entities.summary: Peregrine Laziosi, an Italian saint of the Servite Order, is the patron saint for persons suffering from cancer, AIDS, and other life-threatening illnesses. Born in unknown year, Laziosi lived a life of devotion and spiritual guidance. He became a prominent figure in the Servite Order, leading a life of asceticism and prayer. Throughout his life, Laziosi was revered for his compassion and selflessness. His legacy extends to modern times, with his feast day still celebrated by many. As a testament to his enduring impact, Laziosi's relics are now housed in the Basilica of the Servite Order in Rome, where pilgrims flock to seek his intercession. The Servite Order continues to this day, spreading the teachings of Laziosi and other saints like him. Laziosi's story is a powerful reminder of the transformative power of faith and compassion.
